                                .value_parser({
                                    use ::clap_builder::builder::impl_prelude::*;
                                    let auto = ::clap_builder::builder::_infer_ValueParser_for::<
                                        String,
                                    >::new();
                                    (&&&&&&auto).value_parser()
                                })
                                .action(clap::ArgAction::Set);
                            let arg = arg
                                .help("The git origin for this crate, if any")
                                .long_help(None)
                                .short('o')
                                .long("origin");
                            let arg = arg.required(false);
                            arg
                        });
                    let __clap_app = __clap_app
                        .arg({
                            #[allow(deprecated)]
                            let arg = clap::Arg::new("force_overwrite_pre_commit")
                                .value_name("FORCE_OVERWRITE_PRE_COMMIT")
                                .required(true && clap::ArgAction::SetTrue.takes_values())
                                .value_parser({
                                    use ::clap_builder::builder::impl_prelude::*;
                                    let auto = ::clap_builder::builder::_infer_ValueParser_for::<
                                        bool,
                                    >::new();
                                    (&&&&&&auto).value_parser()
                                })
                                .action(clap::ArgAction::SetTrue);
                            let arg = arg
                                .help(
                                    "If there is already a pre-commit hook present, this option will allow it to be overwritten",
                                )
                                .long_help(None)
                                .short('f');
                            let arg = arg.required(false);
                            arg
                        });
                    __clap_app
                }
            }

        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for CargoBinBasic {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> CargoBinBasic {
                CargoBinBasic {
                    authors: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.authors),
                    description: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.description),
                    repository: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.repository),
                    keywords: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.keywords),
                    categories: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.categories),
                    origin: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.origin),
                    force_overwrite_pre_commit: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                    ),
                }
            }
        }
        impl ConfigureProject for CargoBinBasic {
            fn deinit(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CargoDenyUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        VhooksUninstaller::new(false).uninstall(path),
                        PreCommitUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        LicensesUninstaller::new(None, None).uninstall(path),
                        GithubWorkflowsUninstaller::new(
                                Some(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                        ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                            ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                            ["test".into(), "release".into()],
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ),
                            )
                            .uninstall(path),
                        CommitalyzerUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                        SemverReleaseUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
            fn new(&self, path: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let cratebuilder = CrateBuilder::new(
                    path.join(name),
                    name.into(),
                    (0, 0, 0),
                    self.authors.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.description.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    "MIT OR Apache-2.0".into(),
                    self.repository.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    self.keywords.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.categories.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                );
                cratebuilder.bin()?;
                File::create(cratebuilder.path().join("README.md"))?;
                if let Some(origin) = &self.origin {
                    set_remote_origin(cratebuilder.path(), origin)?;
                }
                self.init(cratebuilder.path())
            }
            fn init(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CargoDenyInstaller::new(
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    ["MIT".into(), "Apache-2.0".into(), "Unicode-3.0".into()],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    VhooksInstaller::new(path.join(".hooks")).install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    PreCommitInstaller::new(
                            Script::CargoBasic,
                            self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    LicensesInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0, License::Unicode3x0],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoBinGeneralRelease(
                                CargoBinGeneralRelease::new(
                                    "CI/CD Release".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "release".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoAnyGeneralTest(
                                CargoAnyGeneralTest::new(
                                    "CI/CD Test".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "test".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CommitalyzerInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Ruleset::ConventionalCommits],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    SemverReleaseInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Plugin::SemverCargo],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            Platform::ArmMacos,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                let mut cargo_toml = CrateBuilder::get_cargo_toml(path)?;
                let include_files_list = CrateBuilder::include_files_ref(
                    &mut cargo_toml,
                )?;
                include_files_list
                    .extend(
                        ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                            ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                [
                                    Value::String("LICENSES/".into()),
                                    Value::String("LICENSE-MIT".into()),
                                    Value::String("LICENSE-Apache-2.0".into()),
                                    Value::String("CHANGELOG.md".into()),
                                ],
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                CrateBuilder::save_cargo_toml(path, &cargo_toml)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn update(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CommitalyzerUpgrader::new().upgrade(path),
                        SemverReleaseUpgrader::new(Platform::ArmMacos).upgrade(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
        }
    }

        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for CargoBinWorkspaced {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> CargoBinWorkspaced {
                CargoBinWorkspaced {
                    authors: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.authors),
                    description: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.description),
                    repository: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.repository),
                    keywords: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.keywords),
                    categories: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.categories),
                    force_overwrite_pre_commit: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                    ),
                }
            }
        }
        impl ConfigureProject for CargoBinWorkspaced {
            fn deinit(&self, _: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                Ok(())
            }
            fn new(&self, path: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let cratebuilder = CrateBuilder::new(
                    path.join(name),
                    name.into(),
                    (0, 0, 0),
                    self.authors.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.description.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    "MIT OR Apache-2.0".into(),
                    self.repository.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    self.keywords.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.categories.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                );
                cratebuilder.bin()?;
                self.init(cratebuilder.path())
            }
            fn init(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let mut cargo_toml = CrateBuilder::get_cargo_toml(path)?;
                let include_files_list = CrateBuilder::include_files_ref(
                    &mut cargo_toml,
                )?;
                include_files_list
                    .extend(
                        ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                            ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                [
                                    Value::String("../LICENSES/".into()),
                                    Value::String("../LICENSE-MIT".into()),
                                    Value::String("../LICENSE-Apache-2.0".into()),
                                    Value::String("../CHANGELOG.md".into()),
                                ],
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                CrateBuilder::save_cargo_toml(path, &cargo_toml)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn update(&self, _: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }

                            let arg = clap::Arg::new("force_overwrite_pre_commit")
                                .value_name("FORCE_OVERWRITE_PRE_COMMIT")
                                .required(true && clap::ArgAction::SetTrue.takes_values())

                                    use ::clap_builder::builder::impl_prelude::*;
                                    let auto = ::clap_builder::builder::_infer_ValueParser_for::<

                                    (&&&&&&auto).value_parser()

                            arg

        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for CargoLibBasic {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> CargoLibBasic {
                CargoLibBasic {
                    authors: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.authors),
                    description: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.description),
                    repository: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.repository),
                    keywords: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.keywords),
                    categories: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.categories),
                    origin: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.origin),
                    force_overwrite_pre_commit: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                    ),
                }
            }

        impl ConfigureProject for CargoLibBasic {
            fn deinit(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CargoDenyUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        VhooksUninstaller::new(false).uninstall(path),
                        PreCommitUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        LicensesUninstaller::new(None, None).uninstall(path),
                        GithubWorkflowsUninstaller::new(
                                Some(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                        ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                            ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                            ["test".into(), "release".into()],
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ),
                            )
                            .uninstall(path),
                        CommitalyzerUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                        SemverReleaseUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
            fn new(&self, path: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let cratebuilder = CrateBuilder::new(
                    path.join(name),
                    name.into(),
                    (0, 0, 0),
                    self.authors.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.description.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    "MIT OR Apache-2.0".into(),
                    self.repository.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    self.keywords.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.categories.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                );
                cratebuilder.lib()?;
                File::create(cratebuilder.path().join("README.md"))?;
                if let Some(origin) = &self.origin {
                    set_remote_origin(cratebuilder.path(), origin)?;
                }
                self.init(cratebuilder.path())
            }
            fn init(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CargoDenyInstaller::new(
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    ["MIT".into(), "Apache-2.0".into(), "Unicode-3.0".into()],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    VhooksInstaller::new(path.join(".hooks")).install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    PreCommitInstaller::new(
                            Script::CargoBasic,
                            self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    LicensesInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0, License::Unicode3x0],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoLibGeneralRelease(
                                CargoLibGeneralRelease::new(
                                    "CI/CD Release".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "release".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoAnyGeneralTest(
                                CargoAnyGeneralTest::new(
                                    "CI/CD Test".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "test".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CommitalyzerInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Ruleset::ConventionalCommits],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    SemverReleaseInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Plugin::SemverCargo],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            Platform::ArmMacos,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                let mut cargo_toml = CrateBuilder::get_cargo_toml(path)?;
                let include_files_list = CrateBuilder::include_files_ref(
                    &mut cargo_toml,
                )?;
                include_files_list
                    .extend(
                        ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                            ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                [
                                    Value::String("LICENSES/".into()),
                                    Value::String("LICENSE-MIT".into()),
                                    Value::String("LICENSE-Apache-2.0".into()),
                                    Value::String("CHANGELOG.md".into()),
                                ],
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                CrateBuilder::save_cargo_toml(path, &cargo_toml)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn update(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CommitalyzerUpgrader::new().upgrade(path),
                        SemverReleaseUpgrader::new(Platform::ArmMacos).upgrade(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
        }
    }

        impl ConfigureProject for CargoLibWorkspaced {
            fn deinit(&self, _: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                Ok(())
            }
            fn new(&self, path: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let cratebuilder = CrateBuilder::new(
                    path.join(name),
                    name.into(),
                    (0, 0, 0),
                    self.authors.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.description.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    "MIT OR Apache-2.0".into(),
                    self.repository.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    self.keywords.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.categories.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                );
                cratebuilder.lib()?;
                self.init(cratebuilder.path())
            }
            fn init(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let mut cargo_toml = CrateBuilder::get_cargo_toml(path)?;
                let include_files_list = CrateBuilder::include_files_ref(
                    &mut cargo_toml,
                )?;
                include_files_list
                    .extend(
                        ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                            ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                [
                                    Value::String("../LICENSES/".into()),
                                    Value::String("../LICENSE-MIT".into()),
                                    Value::String("../LICENSE-Apache-2.0".into()),
                                    Value::String("../CHANGELOG.md".into()),
                                ],
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                CrateBuilder::save_cargo_toml(path, &cargo_toml)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn update(&self, _: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }

                                )
                                .long_help(None)
                                .short('f');
                            let arg = arg.required(false);
                            arg

                    __clap_app

            }

        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for CargoProcMacroBasic {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> CargoProcMacroBasic {
                CargoProcMacroBasic {

                    origin: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.origin),
                    force_overwrite_pre_commit: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(

                    ),
                }
            }

        impl ConfigureProject for CargoProcMacroBasic {
            fn deinit(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CargoDenyUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        VhooksUninstaller::new(false).uninstall(path),
                        PreCommitUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        LicensesUninstaller::new(None, None).uninstall(path),
                        GithubWorkflowsUninstaller::new(
                                Some(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                        ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                            ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                            ["test".into(), "release".into()],
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ),
                            )
                            .uninstall(path),
                        CommitalyzerUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                        SemverReleaseUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
            fn new(&self, path: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let cratebuilder = CrateBuilder::new(
                    path.join(name),
                    name.into(),
                    (0, 0, 0),
                    self.authors.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.description.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    "MIT OR Apache-2.0".into(),
                    self.repository.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    self.keywords.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.categories.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                );
                cratebuilder.proc()?;
                File::create(cratebuilder.path().join("README.md"))?;
                if let Some(origin) = &self.origin {
                    set_remote_origin(cratebuilder.path(), origin)?;
                }
                self.init(cratebuilder.path())
            }
            fn init(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CargoDenyInstaller::new(
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    ["MIT".into(), "Apache-2.0".into(), "Unicode-3.0".into()],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    VhooksInstaller::new(path.join(".hooks")).install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    PreCommitInstaller::new(
                            Script::CargoBasic,
                            self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    LicensesInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0, License::Unicode3x0],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoLibGeneralRelease(
                                CargoLibGeneralRelease::new(
                                    "CI/CD Release".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "release".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoAnyGeneralTest(
                                CargoAnyGeneralTest::new(
                                    "CI/CD Test".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "test".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CommitalyzerInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Ruleset::ConventionalCommits],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    SemverReleaseInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Plugin::SemverCargo],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            Platform::ArmMacos,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                let mut cargo_toml = CrateBuilder::get_cargo_toml(path)?;
                let include_files_list = CrateBuilder::include_files_ref(
                    &mut cargo_toml,
                )?;
                include_files_list
                    .extend(
                        ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                            ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                [
                                    Value::String("LICENSES/".into()),
                                    Value::String("LICENSE-MIT".into()),
                                    Value::String("LICENSE-Apache-2.0".into()),
                                    Value::String("CHANGELOG.md".into()),
                                ],
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                CrateBuilder::save_cargo_toml(path, &cargo_toml)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn update(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CommitalyzerUpgrader::new().upgrade(path),
                        SemverReleaseUpgrader::new(Platform::ArmMacos).upgrade(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
        }
    }

                            let arg = clap::Arg::new("force_overwrite_pre_commit")
                                .value_name("FORCE_OVERWRITE_PRE_COMMIT")
                                .required(true && clap::ArgAction::SetTrue.takes_values())
                                .value_parser({
                                    use ::clap_builder::builder::impl_prelude::*;
                                    let auto = ::clap_builder::builder::_infer_ValueParser_for::<
                                        bool,
                                    >::new();
                                    (&&&&&&auto).value_parser()
                                })
                                .action(clap::ArgAction::SetTrue);
                            let arg = arg
                                .help(
                                    "If there is already a pre-commit hook present, this option will allow it to be overwritten",
                                )
                                .long_help(None)
                                .short('f');
                            let arg = arg.required(false);
                            arg
                        });
                    __clap_app
                }
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for CargoProcMacroWorkspaced {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> CargoProcMacroWorkspaced {
                CargoProcMacroWorkspaced {
                    authors: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.authors),
                    description: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.description),
                    repository: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.repository),
                    keywords: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.keywords),
                    categories: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.categories),
                    force_overwrite_pre_commit: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                    ),
                }
            }
        }
        impl ConfigureProject for CargoProcMacroWorkspaced {
            fn deinit(&self, _: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                Ok(())
            }
            fn new(&self, path: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let cratebuilder = CrateBuilder::new(
                    path.join(name),
                    name.into(),
                    (0, 0, 0),
                    self.authors.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.description.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    "MIT OR Apache-2.0".into(),
                    self.repository.clone().unwrap_or("".into()),
                    self.keywords.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    self.categories.clone().unwrap_or(Vec::new()),
                    ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                );
                cratebuilder.proc()?;
                self.init(cratebuilder.path())
            }
            fn init(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let mut cargo_toml = CrateBuilder::get_cargo_toml(path)?;
                let include_files_list = CrateBuilder::include_files_ref(
                    &mut cargo_toml,
                )?;
                include_files_list
                    .extend(
                        ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                            ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                [
                                    Value::String("../LICENSES/".into()),
                                    Value::String("../LICENSE-MIT".into()),
                                    Value::String("../LICENSE-Apache-2.0".into()),
                                    Value::String("../CHANGELOG.md".into()),
                                ],
                            ),
                        ),
                    );
                CrateBuilder::save_cargo_toml(path, &cargo_toml)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn update(&self, _: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }

        impl ::core::clone::Clone for CargoWorkspaceBasic {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> CargoWorkspaceBasic {
                CargoWorkspaceBasic {
                    origin: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.origin),
                    force_overwrite_pre_commit: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,

                }
            }

        impl ConfigureProject for CargoWorkspaceBasic {
            fn deinit(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CargoDenyUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        VhooksUninstaller::new(false).uninstall(path),
                        PreCommitUninstaller::new().uninstall(path),
                        LicensesUninstaller::new(None, None).uninstall(path),
                        GithubWorkflowsUninstaller::new(
                                Some(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                        ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                            ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                            ["test".into(), "release".into()],
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ),
                            )
                            .uninstall(path),
                        CommitalyzerUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                        SemverReleaseUninstaller::new(None).uninstall(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
            fn new(&self, path: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                let cratebuilder = CrateBuilder::new(
                    path.join(name),
                    name.into(),
                    (0, 0, 0),
                    Vec::new(),
                    "".into(),
                    "MIT OR Apache-2.0".into(),
                    "".into(),
                    Vec::new(),
                    Vec::new(),
                    ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                );
                cratebuilder.workspace()?;
                File::create(cratebuilder.path().join("README.md"))?;
                if let Some(origin) = &self.origin {
                    set_remote_origin(cratebuilder.path(), origin)?;
                }
                self.init(cratebuilder.path())
            }
            fn init(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CargoDenyInstaller::new(
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    ["MIT".into(), "Apache-2.0".into(), "Unicode-3.0".into()],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    VhooksInstaller::new(path.join(".hooks")).install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    PreCommitInstaller::new(
                            Script::CargoBasic,
                            self.force_overwrite_pre_commit,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    LicensesInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0, License::Unicode3x0],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                    ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                    [License::MIT, License::Apache2x0],
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoLibGeneralRelease(
                                CargoLibGeneralRelease::new(
                                    "CI/CD Release".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "release".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    GithubWorkflowsInstaller::new(
                            Workflow::CargoAnyGeneralTest(
                                CargoAnyGeneralTest::new(
                                    "CI/CD Test".into(),
                                    "master".into(),
                                ),
                            ),
                            "test".into(),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    CommitalyzerInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Ruleset::ConventionalCommits],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                self.clean_up_on_error(
                    path,
                    SemverReleaseInstaller::new(
                            Some(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_assume_init_into_vec_unsafe(
                                    ::alloc::intrinsics::write_box_via_move(
                                        ::alloc::boxed::Box::new_uninit(),
                                        [Plugin::SemverCargo],
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            Platform::ArmMacos,
                        )
                        .install(path),
                )?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn update(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), SolarError> {
                self.combine_errors(
                    &[
                        CommitalyzerUpgrader::new().upgrade(path),
                        SemverReleaseUpgrader::new(Platform::ArmMacos).upgrade(path),
                    ],
                )
            }
        }
    }
    pub use cargo_bin_basic::CargoBinBasic;
    pub use cargo_bin_workspaced::CargoBinWorkspaced;
    pub use cargo_lib_basic::CargoLibBasic;
    pub use cargo_lib_workspaced::CargoLibWorkspaced;
    pub use cargo_proc_macro_basic::CargoProcMacroBasic;

    use clap::Subcommand;
    use enum_dispatch::enum_dispatch;
    pub enum Project {
        CargoBinBasic(CargoBinBasic),
        CargoLibBasic(CargoLibBasic),
        CargoProcMacroBasic(CargoProcMacroBasic),
        CargoWorkspaceBasic(CargoWorkspaceBasic),
    }
    #[allow(
        dead_code,
        unreachable_code,
        unused_variables,
        unused_braces,
        unused_qualifications,
    )]
    #[allow(
        clippy::style,
        clippy::complexity,
        clippy::pedantic,
        clippy::restriction,
        clippy::perf,
        clippy::deprecated,
        clippy::nursery,
        clippy::cargo,
        clippy::suspicious_else_formatting,
        clippy::almost_swapped,
        clippy::redundant_locals,
    )]
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl clap::FromArgMatches for Project {
        fn from_arg_matches(
            __clap_arg_matches: &clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, clap::Error> {
            Self::from_arg_matches_mut(&mut __clap_arg_matches.clone())
        }
        fn from_arg_matches_mut(
            __clap_arg_matches: &mut clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, clap::Error> {
            #![allow(deprecated)]
            if let Some((__clap_name, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches)) = __clap_arg_matches
                .remove_subcommand()
            {
                let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                if __clap_name == "cargo-bin-basic"
                    && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("")
                {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::CargoBinBasic(
                            <CargoBinBasic as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "cargo-lib-basic"
                    && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("")
                {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::CargoLibBasic(
                            <CargoLibBasic as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "cargo-proc-macro-basic"
                    && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("")
                {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::CargoProcMacroBasic(
                            <CargoProcMacroBasic as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "cargo-workspace-basic"
                    && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("")
                {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::CargoWorkspaceBasic(
                            <CargoWorkspaceBasic as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                ::std::result::Result::Err(
                    clap::Error::raw(
                        clap::error::ErrorKind::InvalidSubcommand,
                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!(
                                    "the subcommand \'{0}\' wasn\'t recognized",
                                    __clap_name,
                                ),
                            )
                        }),
                    ),
                )
            } else {
                ::std::result::Result::Err(
                    clap::Error::raw(
                        clap::error::ErrorKind::MissingSubcommand,
                        "a subcommand is required but one was not provided",
                    ),
                )
            }
        }
        fn update_from_arg_matches(
            &mut self,
            __clap_arg_matches: &clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<(), clap::Error> {
            self.update_from_arg_matches_mut(&mut __clap_arg_matches.clone())
        }
        fn update_from_arg_matches_mut<'b>(
            &mut self,
            __clap_arg_matches: &mut clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<(), clap::Error> {
            #![allow(deprecated)]
            if let Some(__clap_name) = __clap_arg_matches.subcommand_name() {
                match self {
                    Self::CargoBinBasic(
                        __clap_arg,
                    ) if "cargo-bin-basic" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::CargoLibBasic(
                        __clap_arg,
                    ) if "cargo-lib-basic" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::CargoProcMacroBasic(
                        __clap_arg,
                    ) if "cargo-proc-macro-basic" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::CargoWorkspaceBasic(
                        __clap_arg,
                    ) if "cargo-workspace-basic" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    s => {
                        *s = <Self as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?;
                    }
                }
            }
            ::std::result::Result::Ok(())
        }
    }
    #[allow(
        dead_code,
        unreachable_code,
        unused_variables,
        unused_braces,
        unused_qualifications,
    )]
    #[allow(
        clippy::style,
        clippy::complexity,
        clippy::pedantic,
        clippy::restriction,
        clippy::perf,
        clippy::deprecated,
        clippy::nursery,
        clippy::cargo,
        clippy::suspicious_else_formatting,
        clippy::almost_swapped,
        clippy::redundant_locals,
    )]
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl clap::Subcommand for Project {
        fn augment_subcommands<'b>(__clap_app: clap::Command) -> clap::Command {
            let __clap_app = __clap_app;
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-bin-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoBinBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args(__clap_subcommand)
                    };
                    __clap_subcommand
                });
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-lib-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoLibBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args(__clap_subcommand)
                    };

                });
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-proc-macro-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoProcMacroBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args(
                            __clap_subcommand,
                        )
                    };
                    __clap_subcommand
                });
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-workspace-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoWorkspaceBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args(
                            __clap_subcommand,
                        )
                    };
                    __clap_subcommand
                });
            __clap_app
        }
        fn augment_subcommands_for_update<'b>(
            __clap_app: clap::Command,
        ) -> clap::Command {
            let __clap_app = __clap_app;
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-bin-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoBinBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args_for_update(
                            __clap_subcommand,
                        )
                    };
                    __clap_subcommand
                });
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-lib-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoLibBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args_for_update(
                            __clap_subcommand,
                        )
                    };
                    __clap_subcommand
                });
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-proc-macro-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoProcMacroBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args_for_update(
                            __clap_subcommand,
                        )
                    };
                    __clap_subcommand
                });
            let __clap_app = __clap_app
                .subcommand({
                    let __clap_subcommand = clap::Command::new("cargo-workspace-basic");
                    let __clap_subcommand = __clap_subcommand;
                    let __clap_subcommand = {
                        <CargoWorkspaceBasic as clap::Args>::augment_args_for_update(
                            __clap_subcommand,
                        )
                    };
                    __clap_subcommand
                });
            __clap_app
        }
        fn has_subcommand(__clap_name: &str) -> bool {
            if "cargo-bin-basic" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "cargo-lib-basic" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "cargo-proc-macro-basic" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "cargo-workspace-basic" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            false
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for Project {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> Project {
            match self {
                Project::CargoBinBasic(__self_0) => {
                    Project::CargoBinBasic(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Project::CargoLibBasic(__self_0) => {
                    Project::CargoLibBasic(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Project::CargoProcMacroBasic(__self_0) => {
                    Project::CargoProcMacroBasic(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Project::CargoWorkspaceBasic(__self_0) => {
                    Project::CargoWorkspaceBasic(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
            }
        }
    }

            }

                __clap_arg_matches: &mut clap::ArgMatches,
            ) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, clap::Error> {
                #![allow(deprecated)]
                let v = New {
                    project: {
                        <Project as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    },
                    name: __clap_arg_matches
                        .remove_one::<String>("name")
                        .ok_or_else(|| clap::Error::raw(
                            clap::error::ErrorKind::MissingRequiredArgument,
                            "the following required argument was not provided: name",
                        ))?,
                };
                ::std::result::Result::Ok(v)
            }
            fn update_from_arg_matches(
                &mut self,
                __clap_arg_matches: &clap::ArgMatches,
            ) -> ::std::result::Result<(), clap::Error> {
                self.update_from_arg_matches_mut(&mut __clap_arg_matches.clone())
            }
            fn update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                &mut self,
                __clap_arg_matches: &mut clap::ArgMatches,
            ) -> ::std::result::Result<(), clap::Error> {
                #![allow(deprecated)]
                {
                    #[allow(non_snake_case)]
                    let project = &mut self.project;
                    <Project as clap::FromArgMatches>::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                        project,
                        __clap_arg_matches,
                    )?;
                }
                if __clap_arg_matches.contains_id("name") {
                    #[allow(non_snake_case)]
                    let name = &mut self.name;
                    *name = __clap_arg_matches
                        .remove_one::<String>("name")
                        .ok_or_else(|| clap::Error::raw(
                            clap::error::ErrorKind::MissingRequiredArgument,
                            "the following required argument was not provided: name",
                        ))?;
                }
                ::std::result::Result::Ok(())
            }
        }

            clippy::complexity,
            clippy::pedantic,

                {
                    let __clap_app = __clap_app
                        .group(
                            clap::ArgGroup::new("New")
                                .multiple(true)
                                .args({
                                    let members: [clap::Id; 1usize] = [clap::Id::from("name")];
                                    members
                                }),
                        );
                    let __clap_app = <Project as clap::Subcommand>::augment_subcommands(
                        __clap_app,
                    );
                    let __clap_app = __clap_app
                        .subcommand_required(true)
                        .arg_required_else_help(true);
                    let __clap_app = __clap_app
                        .arg({
                            #[allow(deprecated)]
                            let arg = clap::Arg::new("name")
                                .value_name("NAME")
                                .required(true && clap::ArgAction::Set.takes_values())
                                .value_parser({
                                    use ::clap_builder::builder::impl_prelude::*;
                                    let auto = ::clap_builder::builder::_infer_ValueParser_for::<
                                        String,
                                    >::new();
                                    (&&&&&&auto).value_parser()
                                })
                                .action(clap::ArgAction::Set);
                            let arg = arg
                                .help("The name of the new project to create")
                                .long_help(None)
                                .short('n')
                                .long("name");
                            let arg = arg;
                            arg
                        });
                    __clap_app
                }
            }

                {

                        .group(
                            clap::ArgGroup::new("New")
                                .multiple(true)
                                .args({
                                    let members: [clap::Id; 1usize] = [clap::Id::from("name")];
                                    members
                                }),
                        );
                    let __clap_app = <Project as clap::Subcommand>::augment_subcommands(

                    );

                            arg

    pub use deinit::Deinit;
    use enum_dispatch::enum_dispatch;
    pub use init::Init;
    pub use install::Install;
    pub use new::New;
    pub use uninstall::Uninstall;
    pub use update::Update;
    pub use update_all::UpdateAll;
    pub use upgrade::Upgrade;
    use clap::Subcommand as SC;
    pub enum Subcommand {
        /// Create a new Solar project in a new directory with a configuration.
        New(New),
        /// Initialize a new Solar project with a configuration in the current directory.
        Init(Init),
        /// Deinitializes a solar project.
        Deinit(Deinit),
        /// Updates the configuration of tools on the current project.
        Update(Update),
        /// Updates every tool that has an upgrader found in the project.
        UpdateAll(UpdateAll),
        /// Upgrade a single tool in the solar project.
        Upgrade(Upgrade),
        /// Install tools from the Solar framework to the project.
        Install(Install),
        /// Removes Solar framework tools from the project.
        Uninstall(Uninstall),
    }
    #[allow(
        dead_code,
        unreachable_code,
        unused_variables,
        unused_braces,
        unused_qualifications,
    )]
    #[allow(
        clippy::style,
        clippy::complexity,
        clippy::pedantic,
        clippy::restriction,
        clippy::perf,
        clippy::deprecated,
        clippy::nursery,
        clippy::cargo,
        clippy::suspicious_else_formatting,
        clippy::almost_swapped,
        clippy::redundant_locals,
    )]
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl clap::FromArgMatches for Subcommand {
        fn from_arg_matches(
            __clap_arg_matches: &clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, clap::Error> {
            Self::from_arg_matches_mut(&mut __clap_arg_matches.clone())
        }
        fn from_arg_matches_mut(
            __clap_arg_matches: &mut clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<Self, clap::Error> {
            #![allow(deprecated)]
            if let Some((__clap_name, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches)) = __clap_arg_matches
                .remove_subcommand()
            {
                let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                if __clap_name == "new" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::New(
                            <New as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "init" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::Init(
                            <Init as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "deinit" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::Deinit(
                            <Deinit as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "update" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::Update(
                            <Update as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "update-all" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::UpdateAll(
                            <UpdateAll as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "upgrade" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::Upgrade(
                            <Upgrade as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "install" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::Install(
                            <Install as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                if __clap_name == "uninstall" && !__clap_arg_matches.contains_id("") {
                    return ::std::result::Result::Ok(
                        Self::Uninstall(
                            <Uninstall as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                                __clap_arg_matches,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    );
                }
                ::std::result::Result::Err(
                    clap::Error::raw(
                        clap::error::ErrorKind::InvalidSubcommand,
                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!(
                                    "the subcommand \'{0}\' wasn\'t recognized",
                                    __clap_name,
                                ),
                            )
                        }),
                    ),
                )
            } else {
                ::std::result::Result::Err(
                    clap::Error::raw(
                        clap::error::ErrorKind::MissingSubcommand,
                        "a subcommand is required but one was not provided",
                    ),
                )
            }
        }
        fn update_from_arg_matches(
            &mut self,
            __clap_arg_matches: &clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<(), clap::Error> {
            self.update_from_arg_matches_mut(&mut __clap_arg_matches.clone())
        }
        fn update_from_arg_matches_mut<'b>(
            &mut self,
            __clap_arg_matches: &mut clap::ArgMatches,
        ) -> ::std::result::Result<(), clap::Error> {
            #![allow(deprecated)]
            if let Some(__clap_name) = __clap_arg_matches.subcommand_name() {
                match self {
                    Self::New(__clap_arg) if "new" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::Init(__clap_arg) if "init" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::Deinit(__clap_arg) if "deinit" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::Update(__clap_arg) if "update" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::UpdateAll(__clap_arg) if "update-all" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::Upgrade(__clap_arg) if "upgrade" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::Install(__clap_arg) if "install" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    Self::Uninstall(__clap_arg) if "uninstall" == __clap_name => {
                        let (_, mut __clap_arg_sub_matches) = __clap_arg_matches
                            .remove_subcommand()
                            .unwrap();
                        let __clap_arg_matches = &mut __clap_arg_sub_matches;
                        clap::FromArgMatches::update_from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg,
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?
                    }
                    s => {
                        *s = <Self as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches_mut(
                            __clap_arg_matches,
                        )?;
                    }
                }
            }
            ::std::result::Result::Ok(())
        }
    }

        fn has_subcommand(__clap_name: &str) -> bool {
            if "new" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "init" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "deinit" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "update" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "update-all" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "upgrade" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "install" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            if "uninstall" == __clap_name {
                return true;
            }
            false
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for Subcommand {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> Subcommand {
            match self {
                Subcommand::New(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::New(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Subcommand::Init(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::Init(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Subcommand::Deinit(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::Deinit(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Subcommand::Update(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::Update(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Subcommand::UpdateAll(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::UpdateAll(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Subcommand::Upgrade(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::Upgrade(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Subcommand::Install(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::Install(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
                Subcommand::Uninstall(__self_0) => {
                    Subcommand::Uninstall(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                }
            }
        }
    }
